paired_gate1.method: exact McNemar (two-sided binomial on discordant cells, p=0.5); Holm step-down over all 10 model pairs; paired difference with Newcombe (1998) method-10 interval; conditional odds ratio a_only/b_only with exact Clopper-Pearson-derived interval
paired_gate1.unit: (task, language) cell; outcome = gate 1 pass; failed generation = not pass
paired_gate1.caveat: cells from the same task are not independent across languages; tests treat the 160 cells as independent pairs
